rate.label: Sales tax rate
rate.hint: The rate you charge on every order. Customers see it added at checkout, on receipts and on tickets.
rate.regionDefault: Leave it empty to charge {label} at {rate}%, the rate on prepared food in {region}.

tips.label: Tips
tips.hint: Customers paying online by card can add a tip. It all goes to you.

fee.label: Online service fee
fee.hint: Added to online orders only. Never on pay-at-the-truck or walk-up orders. You keep it.
fee.example: Customers see it before they pay, as one line: “{label} {amount}”.
fee.hatchgrab: HatchGrab adds a {fee} service fee to your customers’ online orders. You don’t pay it and can’t change it.
